method: Each check breaks one thing the lot fixed, in an isolated copy of d5833812 plus this lot, rebuilds, runs the named test or gate, and writes the original bytes back (never git checkout). The named test or gate must fail, the named neighbour must stay green, and a control run after restoring must be green. The chart check removes the N1 refusal from ivr.assertTtsCandidate and runs speech-transition-gate.mjs and tts-helm-selftest.mjs against it.
